quote: indicated to reduce the risk of stroke and systemic embolism in adult patients with non-valvular atrial fibrillation
note: Atrial fibrillation is the population in which stroke/embolism risk is reduced, not the condition the drug treats (rubric's 'reduce the risk of X in patients with Y' pattern).

quote: for the temporary relief of these symptoms associated with menstrual periods: cramps bloating water-weight gain headache backache breast tenderness fatigue
note: Fatigue is explicitly named as a symptom the product relieves, and the edge names that same symptom rather than an underlying disease.

quote: Cirrhosis of the liver accompanied by edema and/or ascites:
note: Ascites is listed as an edematous condition the diuretic treats; the supplied text does not attribute this fluid-removal indication to a partner ingredient rather than hydrochlorothiazide.

quote: VYEPTI is indicated for the preventive treatment of migraine in adults.
note: Migraine is named directly as the condition prevented (FDA and EMA).

quote: Acute Maxillary Sinusitis Caused by Haemophilus influenzae (including β-lactamase producing strains), Streptococcus pneumoniae (penicillin-susceptible strains only), and Moraxella catarrhalis
note: Acute maxillary sinusitis is a named indication in the cefdinir label.

quote: Dermatologic Diseases Bullous dermatitis herpetiformis, Exfoliative dermatitis, Mycosis fungoides, Pemphigus, Severe erythema multiforme (Stevens-Johnson syndrome), Severe psoriasis
note: Mycosis fungoides is a named item in the dermatologic-diseases indication list.

quote: Community-acquired pneumonia due to Chlamydophila pneumoniae, Haemophilus influenzae, Mycoplasma pneumoniae or Streptococcus pneumoniae in patients appropriate for oral therapy.
note: Community-acquired pneumonia is a named indication; the limitation of use only restricts severity/setting and does not negate it.

quote: Symptoms likely to respond in the first week of treatment include: insomnia, feelings of guilt or worthlessness, agitation, psychic and somatic anxiety, suicidal ideation and anorexia.
note: The indication is depression; agitation appears only as a symptom of depression that responds (or as a feature of the depressed population on the combination label), not as a condition treated in its own right.

quote: Bowel rest is needed because of gastrointestinal surgery or its complications such as ileus, fistulae or anastomotic leaks
note: Anastomotic leak is a circumstance that makes enteral feeding inadvisable; the product is indicated as a parenteral nutrition amino-acid source, not to treat the leak.

quote: TEPADINA is indicated for treatment of adenocarcinoma of the breast or ovary.
note: Adenocarcinoma of the breast is named directly as a treatment indication.

quote: indicated for use in combination therapy with a luteinizing hormone-releasing hormone (LHRH) analog for the treatment of Stage D 2 metastatic carcinoma of the prostate
note: Stage D2 metastatic prostate carcinoma is a form of prostate cancer; the edge is a near parent that still describes what is indicated, and combination therapy counts.

quote: Nadolol is contraindicated in bronchial asthma, sinus bradycardia and greater than first degree conduction block, cardiogenic shock, and overt cardiac failure
note: Nadolol is indicated only for angina and hypertension; heart failure appears as a contraindication and warning (the indications-section mention is generic boilerplate about other antihypertensives).
The supplied multivitamin/fluoride supplementation text never mentions anorexia nervosa or any eating disorder.

quote: Neupro is indicated for the treatment of the signs and symptoms of early-stage idiopathic Parkinson's disease as monotherapy
note: EMA text names Parkinson's disease as the treated condition.

quote: indicated for the prevention and treatment of hyperuricaemia in adult patients undergoing chemotherapy for haematologic malignancies at intermediate to high risk of Tumor Lysis Syndrome
note: Haematologic malignancy is the patient population; the condition treated is hyperuricaemia, not the neoplasm.

quote: RITUXAN, in combination with methotrexate, is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with moderately- to severely-active rheumatoid arthritis
note: Rheumatoid arthritis is a named indication on both FDA and EMA text.

quote: Relieves sinus congestion and pressure, helps decongest sinus openings and passages
note: Sinus congestion is named directly as the symptom relieved, matching the edge.

quote: Juvenile idiopathic arthritis Treatment of polyarthritis (rheumatoid factor positive or negative) and extended oligoarthritis in children and adolescents from the age of 2 years
note: Polyarthritis (polyarticular JIA) is named as a treatment indication; rheumatoid arthritis is likewise a polyarticular arthritis.

quote: indicated for up to 12 weeks for the treatment of endoscopically diagnosed esophagitis, including erosive and ulcerative esophagitis, and associated heartburn due to GERD
note: Treating erosive/ulcerative esophagitis and heartburn due to GERD is treatment of the disease's manifestations, which the rubric counts as managing the disease rather than a symptom swap.

quote: Uses relieves symptoms of diarrhea plus bloating, pressure and cramps, commonly referred to as gas
note: One OTC use statement names bloating (a synonym for abdominal distention) as relieved; support is thin and the warnings treat abdominal distention as a stop signal, but the uses text does name it.

quote: in patients with other anaemias aged two years and older. Exjade is also indicated for the treatment of chronic iron overload requiring chelation therapy
note: Anaemia is the underlying illness of the transfused population; the condition treated is chronic iron overload.

quote: The reduction of elevated intraocular pressure (IOP) in patients with open-angle glaucoma or ocular hypertension.
note: OPTN-related open-angle glaucoma is a narrower subtype of the indicated open-angle glaucoma, and IOP reduction is the treatment of that glaucoma.

quote: temporarily relieves these symptoms due to hay fever (allergic rhinitis) or other upper respiratory allergies: runny nose sneezing itching of the nose or throat itchy, watery eyes
note: Relief of the symptoms of allergic rhinitis is management of the disease itself, which the rubric counts as TARGET.

quote: Bacterial Septicemia caused by Pseudomonas aeruginosa , Klebsiella spp., Haemophilus influenzae , Escherichia coli , Serratia spp., Streptococcus pneumoniae , and Staphylococcus aureus
note: Bacterial septicemia/sepsis is a named indication.

quote: For the prevention of recurrence following rheumatic fever and/or chorea: Prophylaxis with oral penicillin on a continuing basis has proven effective in preventing recurrence of these conditions.
note: Prevention of recurrence of chorea is named as an indication, and prevention counts as a treatment target.

quote: Tryngolza is indicated as an adjunct to diet in adult patients for the treatment of genetically confirmed familial chylomicronemia syndrome (FCS).
note: FCS is named directly (EMA as treatment, FDA as TG reduction in FCS).

quote: PAH associated with congenital heart disease with left-to-right shunts (18%)
note: Congenital heart disease is only the etiology/population of the PAH that bosentan treats, not the condition treated.

quote: As adjunctive therapy for short-term administration (to tide the patient over an acute episode or exacerbation) in acute gouty arthritis, acute rheumatic carditis, ankylosing spondylitis
note: Ankylosing spondylitis is a named rheumatic-disorder indication; adjunctive therapy counts.

quote: Benlysta is indicated in combination with background immunosuppressive therapies for the treatment of adult patients with active lupus nephritis.
note: Lupus nephritis is named directly as a treatment indication (FDA and EMA).

quote: As a single agent, for the treatment of adult patients with deleterious or suspected deleterious germline BRCA -mutated (g BRCA m) HER2-negative locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer.
note: gBRCAm HER2-negative advanced breast cancer is a subtype; the edge 'breast cancer' is a near parent that still describes what is indicated.

quote: visual impairment due to myopic choroidal neovascularisation (myopic CNV)
note: Myopic CNV is named as a treated condition in the EMA text.

quote: Dermatologic Diseases Pemphigus Bullous dermatitis herpetiformis Severe erythema multiforme (Stevens-Johnson syndrome) Exfoliative dermatitis Mycosis fungoides Severe psoriasis
note: Severe psoriasis is a listed indication; the edge 'psoriasis' is a near parent that still describes it.

quote: Levofloxacin tablets are indicated for the treatment of acute bacterial exacerbation of chronic bronchitis (ABECB)
note: Acute (bacterial) exacerbation of chronic bronchitis is a named indication.

quote: indicated for the treatment of patients with intermittent claudication on the basis of chronic occlusive arterial disease of the limbs
note: Chronic occlusive arterial disease of the limbs is peripheral vascular disease, and the label itself frames this as 'when treating peripheral vascular disease'.

quote: Apply an appropriate amount to the palm of your hand or bathing utensil with water to form a lather and gently lather over the body, then rinse off with water.
note: The only supplied text is a body-wash directions statement, a different product entirely, so the edge cannot be judged.

quote: symptomatic parkinsonism, which may follow injury to the nervous system by carbon monoxide intoxication and/or manganese intoxication
note: Carbon monoxide intoxication is only the cause of the parkinsonism that carbidopa treats; the poisoning itself is not treated.

quote: indicated in adults for the prevention and treatment of secondary hyperparathyroidism associated with Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) Stages 3 and 4
note: Chronic kidney disease is the setting; the condition treated is secondary hyperparathyroidism.
